tei:div.tei:p: (743)klong chen snying gi thig le lasaḥ gza' rgod srog gi spu gri bzhugasaḥ hrīḥshag tu raṃ nā ga tsirta traṃ ma ma yo za 'gram ha he yo ke sha la jaḥjaḥ hrīḥ dur khrod rab 'jigs rtsub 'gyur tshalaḥ khrag zhags dba' klong 'khrugs pa'i dbusaḥ bka' srung gza' bdud rā hu laḥ srog gi spu gri gshegs su gsolaḥ sku mdog dud kha sbrul mjug g.yoḥ dbu dgu bya rog gdong gis mjesaḥ phyag bzhi mda' gzhu zhags pa dang ཿ chu srin rgyal mtshan rngam stabs 'jinaḥ 'khor du gdong mo rnam bzhi dang ཿ (744)gza' brgyad rgyu skar nyi shu brgyadaḥ lce spyang bdud bya khyi nag dang ཿ dregs pa sde brgyad dmag gi bskoraḥ 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus kunaḥ nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong nas gshegasaḥ dam tshig chen po'i gdan la bzhugasaḥ dmar chen khrag gi arghaṃ dang ཿ dbang lnga'i me tog sha gsur sprinaḥ zhun chen mar me mkhris pa'i chabaḥ sha rus zhal zas thod rnga'i sgraḥ rkang gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrogaḥ (745)dmar chen gtor ma ri ltar spungasaḥ sman rag bdud rtsi mtsho ltar bskyilaḥ mthun rdzas spyan gzigs skar ltar bkramaḥ bzhes dgu'i longs spyod sprin ltar 'duḥ mthun pa'i dam rdzas sna tshogs kyisaḥ gza' bdud chen po'i thugs dam bskang ཿ rā hu la yi thugs dam bskang ཿ sde brgyad dmags dpon thugs dam bskang ཿ gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang ཿ drang srong brgyad kyi (746)thugs dam bskang ཿ rgyu skar nyer brgyad thugs dam bskang ཿ dregs pa sde brgyad thugs dam bskang ཿ las mkhan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang ཿ thugs dam bskang la bar chad solaḥ 'gal 'khrul nongs pa dbyings su bskangasaḥ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod laḥ log par 'dren pa'i dgra dang bgegasaḥ kha rlangs dug gi spu gris sodaḥ brgyud 'jin slob ma bu bzhin skyongasaḥ bka' gsang gnyan po'i bstan pa spelaḥ (747)(748)bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mjodaḥ

ces brjod gtor ma gtsang par gshegasaḥ e maḥ rgyal dbang padma thod phreng giḥ rdo rje'i dam tshig srung ma 'diḥ mthu rtsal rno myur thog dang 'draḥ bka' nyan 'khu ldog gdugs rtsub cheḥ de phyir snying las gces par zungasaḥ sa ma yaḥ ཿ
